## 🚨 Bug Summary

<!-- Clearly describe the bug in one or two sentences. -->

* (Example) The itinerary detail screen displays a blank page after refreshing the browser.

### 👣 Steps to Reproduce

<!-- Provide the exact steps required to reproduce the bug. -->

1. Open the itinerary detail screen.
2. Refresh the browser.
3. Check the rendered screen.

## 🎯 Expected Behavior

<!-- Describe what you expected to happen. -->

### Expected:
The itinerary detail screen should render normally.

## 🖥️ Actual Behavior

<!-- Describe what actually happened. -->

### Actual:
The screen displayed a blank page.

* Affected Screen or API: (Example: Itinerary detail screen / GET /api/v1/itineraries/{id})
* Browser / Device / OS: (Example: Chrome / MacBook Air / macOS)
